runs.purpose: 1k-event alignment check after moving module ~6.4 mm toward ch 6/7 row
runs.notes: Waveforms in mV (calibrated), not ADC (x4.096 to ADC-eq). NEW ARRAY LAYOUT (matches historical data; the single MCP TR0 is duplicated into both DRS groups): arrays 0-7 = DT5742 ch 0-7; array 8 = MCP TR0 copy, group 0; arrays 9-16 = DT5742 ch 8-15; array 17 = MCP TR0 copy, group 1. Verified in data: corr(arr8,arr17)=0.998 (same MCP pulse), arr16 = LG6's HG partner (corr 0.90). DT5742-native HG pairing unchanged from run 12 (4-13, 5-12, 6-15, 7-14). Post-trigger 74%: prompt pulses at sample ~52, only ~40 pre-samples for baselines (recommend restoring ~70%). HG gains raised ~2x (MIP MPVs 255-325 ADC-eq vs 121-165 in run 12; reference channels unchanged). ALIGNMENT (correct mapping): miss fraction 7.9% +/- 3.1% (was 42.9%); left/right = 0.96 +/- 0.06 (centered); bottom/top = 1.25 +/- 0.07 (was 1.41) - possibly ~1-2 mm still low, within calibration systematics of centered.

runs.purpose: First 20k production run at 5 GeV, position same as run 14
runs.notes: COMPLETE: 20,000 events, zero event-number gaps. QC clean (QCv2.C): all channels healthy, HG clipping in beam events 0.2-0.6% (was 1-12% in run 12 - offset fix worked), Cherenkov coincidence 9.08% (1,816 e). MIP MPVs 329-404 ADC-eq (+25% vs run 14: SiPM bias raised +1 V on all LG and HG channels for this run - FINAL operating point for the campaign; run-15 MIPs are the reference calibration). ALIGNMENT: miss 7.9+/-0.6%; residual offset now significant: bottom/top 1.255+/-0.014, left/right 0.909+/-0.010 => beam ~2-3 mm low, ~1 mm right of module center. NEW: centered beam produces a real electron response peak in SumLG: mean 2992+/-36, sigma/E = 33.6+/-1.4% (position-smearing dominated; run-12 edge bound says intrinsic ~10%). Green light for energy scan with geometry/gains frozen.
